findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_answers" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The exact answer each engine gave to each tracked buyer question in the latest deep measurement for areyoufoundbyai.com: engine, model, date, whether this busin…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "demo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_post_brief · Private data: get_visibility, get_answers, get_context · Public sink: get_share_of_voice, get_post_brief · Destructive: get_mentions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_post_brief · Private data: get_visibility, get_answers, get_context · Public sink: get_share_of_voice, get_post_brief · Destructive: get_mentions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
